$comment: Brand tokens for the bundled example film. Every value records where it came from; nothing here is guessed. The accent is the brand's own published colour. The neutrals are the film's own design choices, derived from the brand's white-ground site, and are marked as such rather than presented as brand values.
source: https://scaefy.com (accent colour read from the site's own stylesheet)

accent.use: decoration only: progress bar, card edge. Never text.

accentInk.source: derived: the brand accent darkened until it passes contrast on white
accentInk.use: accent text: kickers and emphasised words

typography.$comment: This example uses a system font stack so the film runs offline with zero dependencies. A real production vendors the brand's licensed font files under assets/brand/fonts/ and declares them with @font-face — see the brand-asset-intake skill.

safeMargin.source: pack default; 1080p box is x 154-1766, y 86-994

logo.source: scaefy.com — the real file, never redrawn
logo.note: Trademark of its owner; not covered by this repository's MIT licence.

contrast.$comment: Measured with the brand-asset-intake skill's own check-contrast.py, not assumed. The first pass caught a real defect: the brand accent was being used for text and fails every threshold on white, so an accessible accent ink was derived for text and the brand accent kept for decoration.
